_watchers_why: health.py's probe_watchers reads its estate-probe targets from this block (issue #1 ask 2). Every key defaults to the previously hardcoded live values, so omitting the whole block changes nothing. Overrides merge per watcher - give only the keys you change. enabled:false skips that probe AND declares the omission in every verdict (w_checks_complete reports 'disabled by config'), never a silent green. openrappter.labels is the same key the spin scan unions into its candidate labels - one key, one read path.
